problems: The hub reads as a face, not a station module: two dark round windows sit just above a curved gray equator band, which looks like eyes and a smile, and the red-tipped antenna makes it look like a robot head. Replace the three front windows with an even ring of small portholes all around the hub, and add a second band so the hub reads as a built pressure module.

The blue planet barely shows: only a thin dark sliver at the right edge, so the setting doesn't read as space with a planet. Move it in and up so a clear arc of it sits low behind the station on the right.
